# vaultwarden_organization_group_member (Resource)

This resource adds an organization user to a group.

Other members of the group and other groups of the user are left unchanged. Groups require the `ORG_GROUPS_ENABLED=true` setting on the Vaultwarden server.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "vaultwarden_organization" "example" {
  name = "Example"
}

resource "vaultwarden_organization_group" "example" {
  organization_id = vaultwarden_organization.example.id
  name            = "Engineering"
}

resource "vaultwarden_organization_user" "example" {
  organization_id = vaultwarden_organization.example.id
  email           = "user@example.com"
}

resource "vaultwarden_organization_group_member" "example" {
  organization_id      = vaultwarden_organization.example.id
  group_id             = vaultwarden_organization_group.example.id
  organization_user_id = vaultwarden_organization_user.example.id
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `group_id` (String) ID of the group, for example `vaultwarden_organization_group.example.id`
- `organization_id` (String) ID of the organization
- `organization_user_id` (String) ID of the organization user, for example `vaultwarden_organization_user.example.id`

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) ID of the group membership, in the format `<organization_id>/<group_id>/<organization_user_id>`

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import vaultwarden_organization_group_member.example <org_id>/<group_id>/<organization_user_id>
```
